[[File:StolenPie-SWG.jpg|thumb|right|A piece of pie stolen from a spacer.]]
[[File:TeekPie.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Teek (Teek)|Teek]] overindulges on pie.]]
{{Quote|Look what we've been picking. We can make a pie.|[[Cindel Towani]], to [[Noa Briqualon]]|<ref name="Ewoks: The Battle for Endor">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref>}}
'''Pie''', or in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], '''''patogga''''', was a general term for a variety of foodstuffs.

Pie was normally a disc-shaped baked good, which could be classed as a main course or a dessert based on its content.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] embarked on a quest to kill a number of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] after they stole the spacer's pie. This type of pie was not explicitly named, but strongly resembled a food called [[Corellian air cake|air cake]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

[[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] were known to partake of several different types of pie.<ref name="BEPS">''[[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]]''</ref><ref name="FaaE">''[[Fuzzy as an Ewok: Things to See, Touch, and Smell from the Forest Moon of Endor]]''</ref><ref name="HHoH">{{Ewoks|Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)}}</ref>

[[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyers]] were sometimes referred to as "pie-shaped."<ref name="DSN">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
